messages.author: f7825395596c3639
messages.subject: Exception in rmr2 reducer
parts:
Hi,  I am running lm() regression on a data set in my reducer.  I am using the rmr2 package.   I am doing lm(), step and summary and I want to output the value of the summary.

I do a keyval(key, sumfit).  

I get the message saying map and reduce have completed 100% Then I get this exception

Error: java.lang.RuntimeException: PipeMapRed.waitOutputThreads(): subprocess failed with code 1
    at org.apache.hadoop.streaming.PipeMapRed.waitOutputThreads(PipeMapRed.java:320)
    at org.apache.hadoop.streaming.PipeMapRed.mapRedFinished(PipeMapRed.java:533)
    at org.apache.hadoop.streaming.PipeReducer.close(PipeReducer.java:134)
    at org.apache.hadoop.mapred.ReduceTask.runOldReducer(ReduceTask.java:470)
    at org.apache.hadoop.mapred.ReduceTask.run(ReduceTask.java:407)
    at org.apache.hadoop.mapred.YarnChild$2.run(YarnChild.java:157)
    at java.security.AccessController.doPrivileged(Native Method)
    at javax.security.auth.Subject.doAs(Subject.java:396)
    at org.apache.hadoop.security.UserGroupInformation.doAs(UserGroupInformation.java:1408)
    at org.apache.hadoop.mapred.YarnChild.main(YarnChild.java:152)

I am using output.format = "text" in my mapreduce() function.

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1205] Exception in rmr2 reducer
parts:
Please follow the bug reporting guidelines and I will try to troubleshoot the problem. I could guess that your choice of output format doesn't match very well the complexity of the object you are trying to write. There is really no sensible use case for a text output format other than natural language generation. It exists mostly for completeness. Try to leave the format at defaults. But don't make me guess, please put together a bug report.

Antonio
